query: What should I work on next?
expected_behavior: Loads starting-roadmap-work before answering
Lists the goal labels and a goal's issues with gh instead of reading a roadmap file in docs/
Picks the first open issue that the goal's acceptance issue lists, not the lowest issue number

query: Start issue 1305 and open a PR when it is done.
expected_behavior: Assigns the issue with gh issue edit --add-assignee @me before branching
Creates one branch for the one issue
Opens the PR with gh pr create --draft and Closes #NNN in the body
Pushes each atomic commit to the draft PR
Runs gh pr ready only when the acceptance gate is verified
Does not bundle a second issue into the same PR

query: Every issue with the goal:opening label is closed except the acceptance issue. Wrap the goal up.
expected_behavior: Checks that the PR closing the acceptance issue carries the acceptance record from docs/tools/sidebar-acceptance.md
Records the outcome in that PR, not in a milestone description or docs/

query: File an issue: the frustum cull test in Frustum.swift line 40 is slow, it iterates an Array.
expected_behavior: Writes the body as intent: the goal, the measured cost, and an acceptance gate in observable terms

expected_behavior: Does not load starting-roadmap-work or query GitHub milestones
Makes the rename directly

query: Start the next issue of goal:opening. The first open issue it lists already has a draft PR.

Skips the issue with the open PR and takes the next open issue the acceptance issue lists

query: While working issue 1305 I noticed the BSA reader crashes on an empty folder name, and the record lookup could use a dictionary to be faster.
expected_behavior: Files the crash as a new issue with the bug label instead of fixing it in the 1305 PR
Files the speed idea as its own issue whose title states the win

query: Update the Gameplay systems milestone description now that the magic work merged.
expected_behavior: Keeps the description to the scope, spec references, and legal notes
Adds no dates, issue or PR numbers, outcome, or status to the description

expected_behavior: Checks the rest of the shader for more missing terms, such as normal maps and specular

expected_behavior: Puts the issue in exactly one area milestone, the area of the root cause, such as Actors, animation + physics or Rendering + audio
